title: SQL Injection Hidden in a Tracking Cookie
learning_objectives: Recognise that a SQL injection sink can live in a Cookie header, not just the URL
Match a UNION SELECT's column count to the original query in SQLite
Exfiltrate a secret column (internal_config.license_key) and use it to unlock a gated endpoint
flag_hint: /solve reads the flag file and returns it in a text/plain body when ?license matches the seeded internal_config.license_key; otherwise it answers HTTP 402.
inspired_by: PortSwigger 'SQL injection vulnerability in a cookie' + UNION-based extraction patterns
